Hi Eric,

Good to hear the power supply finally arrived. I am Hal, the technical specialist at HeliumDeploy, and I will help you get the miner connected.

Your screenshot did not come through on my side, so I cannot see what it shows. I have passed your question and the screenshot to JD, our hardware lead. He picks it up today at 10am Eastern, and his answer will come to you by email in this thread. Here is how the connection works in the meantime.

First, keep the miner and the new power supply unplugged from the wall the whole time you work on them.

The Mean Well has one row of screw terminals with labels printed above them. On the left are the three mains terminals: L, N and the earth symbol. Your mains cable connects here: brown to L, blue to N and green/yellow to earth. On the right are the output terminals, marked -V and +V. The miner's power cable connects here: black (negative) to -V and red (positive) to +V.

The easiest way to get it right is to copy the old power supply. Each wire goes to the terminal with the same label on the new one. Loosen the screw, put the bare end of the wire fully under the clamp and tighten it firmly. No copper should show outside the terminal.

Before you plug anything in, check two things. Red must be on +V and black on -V, because the wrong way round can damage the miner. Then put the plastic cover back over the terminals.

If your wires do not look like this, or anything is unclear, please do not power it on. Wait for JD's reply. A clear photo of the old power supply's terminals with the wires still attached will also help him.

If you would like a faster answer, the community and JD are very active on our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf. Mention @nullhashrate (that is JD).

Best regards, Hal
